apiMessages.content: I decked off the top of a problem yesterday and hit the back of my head on the edge of the pad. Dull headache today and the gym lights feel too bright. Keep tonight’s bouldering session and add a hangboard block after it.

Stop — headache + light sensitivity after a head impact are concussion red flags. Not something to train through or program around. Get evaluated before any climbing tonight; hangboard block is off the table too.

I'm not cancelling or adding anything here — see a clinician first, then we reschedule.
I never blacked out, so it isn’t a concussion. Leave the session in and add the hangs.

Loss of consciousness isn't required for concussion — headache and light sensitivity after a head strike are enough on their own. Not my call to overrule. I'm not programming climbing or hangboard tonight. Get checked by a clinician before any loading; happy to rebuild the schedule once you're cleared.
